chunks: And it is reported from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'If anything could have sufficed you from death, it would have been Al-Talbeyn.' So it was said, 'O Messenger of Allah, and what is Al-Talbeyn?' He said: 'Al-Hasou with milk, Al-Hasou with milk,' and he repeated it three times.

key_terms.التَّلْبِينَةُ: Al-Talbeyn, a specific type of food or soup mentioned in the hadith.
key_terms.الْحَسْوُ: Al-Hasou, described here as a meat and vegetable soup or broth.
key_terms.بِاللَّبَنِ: With milk, indicating the ingredient mixed with the soup.
key_terms.عَنِ الْمَوْتِ: From death, referring to the prevention or delay of death.

ai.seo_question: What is Al-Talbeyn and what did the Prophet say about its ability to prevent death?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) highlights Al-Talbeyn (a soothing porridge made of barley and milk) as the most potent natural remedy, suggesting its efficacy is so profound that if any food could avert death, it would be this specific preparation. His repetition of 'Al-Hasou with milk' three times underscores the importance of this simple, nourishing diet in Islamic prophetic medicine for restoring vitality and comfort. This tradition reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the practical application of Sunnah in daily health and wellness.

en.hubeali:
And it is reported, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Prophetsaww said: ‘If anything could have sufficed you from the death, it would have been Al-Talbeyn which would have sufficed you’. So it was said, ‘O Rasool-Allahsaww! And what is Al-Talbeyn?’ Hesaww said: ‘Al Hasou (meat and vegetable soup) with the milk, Al-Hasou (meat and vegetable soup) with the milk’, and hesaww repeated it three times’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated from abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘If anything can help one against death it can only be al- Talbinah.’ It was asked, ‘O Messenger of Allah, what is al-Talbinah?’ ‘It is al-Hasa’ (flour cooked with oil, sweet or without sweet) with milk, it is al-Hasa’ with milk,’ he (the Messenger of Allah) repeated it three times.’
“Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Shammun from al-Asamm from Misma‘ ibn ‘Abd al-Malik from abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, a similar Hadith.”
